title: Without Vendor Order Management, bills and vendor credits are plain text
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as a user whose custom role has "Reports → Page Access" but not "Vendor Order Management → View" or "Vendor Order Management → Create & Edit".
  • Have a vendor with an unpaid bill A received at your current location and an unused vendor credit A from a vendor return made at your current location.
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 px wide.
  • Open A/P Detail (Reports, then "A/P Aging Detail" under ACCOUNTS PAYABLE in the left menu).
  • Leave the report with that vendor ticked and every bucket expanded.
custom_steps:
1. Look at bill A's and vendor credit A's numbers.
  2. Click bill A's number.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Both are plain text.

Step 2:

  • Nothing opens.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter", Confluence 947650561, version 9 (23 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 26 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11315, story SV-11537 (Story 7, Document links open where they can)

  • S7-N2: “A document the user lacks the permission for shows as plain text.”
  • S7-R9: “On A/P Detail and A/P Unpaid Invoices, a vendor credit's number links to the vendor return it came from, under the same rules and permissions as a bill (S7-R6). A vendor credit that did not come from a vendor return shows as plain text.”
  • Story 7 Prerequisites: “A bill opens for a user with 'Vendor Order Management → View' or 'Vendor Order Management → Create & Edit'.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.
